requirement.description: {data_dave} suggested using open source tools for automation. He would accept some manual processes if it keeps costs low.
requirement.fact: {data_dave} suggested using open source tools for automation.
requirement.reading: He would accept some manual processes if it keeps costs low.

speaker.name: Data Dave
speaker.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.objection: You are counting my open source suggestion as a free concession on cost. Please acknowledge that I am accepting some manual work only to keep the project affordable.
output.correction: I did not mean to trade governance for cheap tools. I meant we should use open source automation where possible and keep manual steps only when they save money.
